newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX FALLS 0.026PTS TO 101.574.
newsitem.headline: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX FALLS 0.026PTS TO 101.574.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds lost 0.026 points in Tuesday's trading to 101.574, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.434 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, fell 0.036 points to 97.856, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.212 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 0.645 points to 1,115.384.
